tags.description:
AP Templates are defining Wi-Fi and AP settings that can be assigned to Access Points based on different types of rules.

AP Templates must be assigned to one or multiple sites to be used.
tags.name: Orgs AP Templates

get.description: List organization AP templates that define AP matching rules, port configuration, Wi-Fi, and mesh settings for assignment to sites.

post.description: Create an organization AP template with AP matching rules, port configuration, Wi-Fi settings, and mesh settings.

delete.description: Delete an organization AP template by template ID from this organization.

vlan_id.description:
Optional to specify the VLAN ID for a tunnel if forwarding is for `wxtunnel`, `mxtunnel` or `site_mxedge`.
  * if vlan_id is not specified then it will use first one in vlan_ids[] of the mxtunnel.
  * if forwarding == site_mxedge, vlan_ids comes from site_mxedge (`mxtunnel` under site setting)

vlan_ids.description: If `forwarding`==`limited`, comma separated list of additional VLAN IDs allowed on this port

wxtunnel_id.description: If `forwarding`==`wxtunnel`, the port is bridged to the vlan of the session

wxtunnel_remote_id.description: If `forwarding`==`wxtunnel`, the port is bridged to the vlan of the session

ap_port_config_dynamic_vlan.description: Dynamic VLAN assignment settings for AP port authentication

default_vlan_id.description: Fallback VLAN ID used when RADIUS does not return a dynamic VLAN match

enabled.description: Whether dynamic VLAN assignment is enabled for this AP port

type.description: Mapping mode for interpreting dynamic VLAN attributes returned by RADIUS

vlans.description: Mapping entries for RADIUS-assigned VLAN values on this AP port. For `type`==`airespace-interface-name`, the property key is the Airespace interface name returned by RADIUS (e.g. "guest"), and the value is the corresponding VLAN ID (e.g. 100). For `type`==`standard`, the property key is the VLAN ID number returned by RADIUS, and the value is ignored.

ap_port_config_dynamic_vlan_type.description: Mapping mode for interpreting dynamic VLAN attributes returned by RADIUS.\ \ enum: `airespace-interface-name`, where the VLAN is determined by parsing\ \ the RADIUS attribute as an Airespace interface name (e.g. "guest"\ \ would map to VLAN 100), or `standard`, where the VLAN is determined by parsing\ \ the RADIUS attribute as a standard VLAN ID number

ap_port_config_forwarding.description:
enum: 
  * `all`: local breakout, All VLANs
  * `limited`: local breakout, only the VLANs configured in `port_vlan_id` and `vlan_ids`
  * `mxtunnel`: central breakout to an Org Mist Edge (requires `mxtunnel_id`)
  * `site_mxedge`: central breakout to a Site Mist Edge (requires `mxtunnel_name`)
  * `wxtunnel`': central breakout to an Org WxTunnel (requires `wxtunnel_id`)

ap_port_config_mac_auth_protocol.description: if `enable_mac_auth`==`true`, allows user to select an authentication protocol. enum: `eap-md5`, `eap-peap`, `pap`

apiToken.description:
Preferred authentication method for automation and integrations. Send the API token in the HTTP `Authorization` header.

**Format**:
  `Authorization: Token {apitoken}`

**Notes**:
* An API token generated for a specific admin has the same privileges as that admin
* An API token is automatically removed if it is not used for more than 90 days
* SSO admins cannot generate admin API tokens. Use organization API tokens when scoped Org/Site privileges are needed.
apiToken.name: Authorization

csrfToken.description:
Session-based authentication for browser or login/password flows. After a successful [Login](/#operations/login) request, Mist returns a `csrftoken` cookie. Send that value in the `X-CSRFToken` header on later API requests that use the login session.

**Format**:
```
X-CSRFToken: vwvBuq9qkqaKh7lu8tNc0gkvBfEaLAmx
```

For automation, API Token authentication is preferred.
csrfToken.name: X-CSRFToken
